title: A Protocol for the Echo
author: Mirabel Crane
blurb: Astrid Lockridge, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
